docs.title: About Me 🇵🇰
docs.text:
👋 Assalam-o-Alaikum! I'm a passionate Data Scientist from Pakistan. 📊✨

With a love for numbers, patterns, and problem-solving, I specialize in turning raw data into meaningful insights. Whether it's building predictive models, visualizing trends, or optimizing processes, I enjoy every step of the data journey.

docs.title: A Little More About Me:
docs.text:
• 🎓 Education: Always learning and growing in the field of data science.
  • 💻 Skills: Python, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, and more.
  • 🌟 Hobbies: Cricket 🏏, chai ☕, and exploring new technologies.

Let's connect and make data-driven magic happen! 🚀

"Data is the new oil, and I'm here to refine it!"

docs.title: 📄 Summary
docs.text: Passionate and detail-oriented Data Scientist with expertise in data analysis, machine learning, Artificial Intelligence(Ai) and statistical modeling. Adept at transforming complex datasets into actionable insights to drive business decisions.

docs.text:
